title: Gopala establishes Pala rule
detail: Britannica describes Gopala's rise in a period of anarchy as the foundation point of Pala power in Bengal.

title: Imperial expansion under Dharmapala and Devapala
detail: Under Dharmapala and Devapala, Pala influence expanded beyond Bengal into wider north Indian geopolitical struggles.

title: Monastic patronage links Bengal to the Buddhist world
detail: Pala patronage helped sustain major Buddhist institutions such as Somapura, linking Bengal to wider intellectual and monastic networks across South Asia.
